[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:385YE Summer]][[Category:Grand Inspiration]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Casinea, Seconded: Temeschwar">Commission the Grand Inspiration of the Way in Bastion. 1000 white granite, 250 thrones, 3 years.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in [[Bastion]] as per the '''[[Blood_will_thicken#A_Question_of_Scale|Blood will thicken]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed
* This motion received support from citizens of the Marches through a [[385YE_Summer_Solstice_Synod_judgements#Judgement_56|mandate]] enacted by '''Friar John of the Mourn''' during the Summer Solstice 385YE
* This motion received support from citizens of the Brass Coast through a [[385YE_Summer_Solstice_Synod_judgements#Judgement_71|mandate]] enacted by '''Sufyan i Zuhri i Erigo''' during the Summer Solstice 385YE
* This motion received support from citizens of Highguard through a [[385YE_Summer_Solstice_Synod_judgements#Judgement_125|mandate]] enacted by '''Eli of the Cenotaph''' during the Summer Solstice 385YE
* This motion received support from citizens of Wintermark through a [[385YE_Autumn_Equinox_Synod_judgements#Judgement_113|mandate]] enacted by '''Eldrid Vestardottir''' during the Autumn Equinox 385YE
* This motion received support from citizens of Navarr through a [[385YE_Autumn_Equinox_Synod_judgements#Judgement_134|mandate]] enacted by '''Fintan Nighthaven''' during the Autumn Equinox 385YE
* This motion received support from citizens of the League through a [[385YE_Winter_Solstice_Synod_judgements#Judgement_30|mandate]] enacted by '''Rafael Barossa d'Apulian''' during the Winter Solstice 385YE
* This motion received support from citizens of Dawn through a [[385YE_Winter_Solstice_Synod_judgements#Judgement_216|mandate]] enacted by '''Darian Numbers''' during the Winter Solstice 385YE
* This motion is receiving support from citizens of Highguard due to the decision of the Benefactors Council
* This motion was [[388YE_Spring_Equinox_Senate_sessions#Amend_Grand_Inspiration_of_the_Way|amended]] during the Spring Equinox 388YE to incorporate seven great bells into the original design, based on [[Lay_the_foundations#Let_the_Bells_Ring_Out|designs]] presented as a result of the Highborn Assembly's highest calling
* This motion was amended twice during the Summer Solstice 388YE; first to [[388YE_Summer_Solstice_Senate_sessions#Amend_Grand_Inspiration_of_the_Way_I|incorporate]] gardens for the [[Voice of Virtue|Voices of Virtue]], and second to [[388YE_Summer_Solstice_Senate_sessions#Amend_Grand_Inspiration_of_the_Way_II|incorporate]] a choristers balcony. Both of these amendments were based on [[A_lasting_commitment|designs]] presented as a result of the Highborn Assembly's highest calling

==Date==
* Summer 385YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per the wind of fortune
* 951 wains of white granite
* 49 wains of mithril
* 2230 crowns in labour costs
* Three years to construct

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Grand_Inspiration_of_the_Way}}
==Outcome==
* Once completed, this edifice will ensure that the Empire is recognised as the undisputed source of spiritual guidance for all followers of the Way in the known world
* Citizens of Highguard will provide 12 wains of white granite and 36 crowns every season until it is completed or until the Benefactors Council direct the funds elsewhere
* Nations can no longer [[Pride_and_paragons#The_Grand_Inspiration|commit themselves to supporting the project]]. 
* Citizens of the Marches provided 16 wains of white granite and 32 crowns every season until the start of the Summer Solstice 386YE
* Citizens of the Brass Coast provided 12 wains of white granite and 24 crowns every season until the start of the Summer Solstice 386YE (this amount was reduced to 8 wains of white granite and 16 crowns as the Brass Coast did not control Madruga)
* Citizens of Wintermark provided 12 wains of white granite and 24 crowns every season until the start of the Autumn Equinox 386YE
* Citizens of Navarr provided 12 wains of white granite and 24 crowns every season until the start of the Autumn Equinox 386YE (this amount was reduced to 8 wains of white granite and 16 crowns as Navarr did not control Therunin)
* Citizens of the League provided 20 wains of white granite and 40 crowns every season until the start of the Winter Solstice 386YE
* Citizens of Dawn provided 16 wains of white granite and 32 crowns every season until the start of the Winter Solstice 386YE

==Notes==
Work to actually build the grand inspiration could not begin until a suitably inspiring design was chosen to serve as the basis of the construction. This was achieved at the Summer Solstice 385YE, and work actually constructing the temple-city began in the following months.
